note: Pinned dependencies for G1. All source tarballs were downloaded once, sha256-recorded here, extracted from these exact archives, and built from those sources. No 'latest' branches, no uncontrolled downloads.

toolchain.name: WinLibs MinGW-w64 (portable, extracted locally; no system change)
toolchain.license: GPL-3.0-or-later with runtime exceptions (GCC runtime libraries); MinGW-w64 runtime per its bundled licenses
toolchain.rationale: Host had no usable C++ toolchain (MSVC 2022/2019 installs exist but lack cl.exe and Windows SDK). A portable MinGW keeps the host clean and the build reproducible.

dependencies.license: LGPL-2.1-only OR CDDL-1.0 (per upstream LICENSE.LGPL / LICENSE.CDDL)
dependencies.role: RAW decoding + P0 baseline postprocessing behind RawDecoderAdapter (ADR-0002, Proposed)
dependencies.rationale: Latest stable upstream tag at pin time (2026-09-30); release tag, not a snapshot. Technical choice only; distribution/licensing model remains a legal review item (docs/09 section 9.4).

dependencies.role: Deflate support required by LibRaw for some RAW containers (e.g. deflate-compressed DNG).
dependencies.rationale: Latest stable tag at pin time.

dependencies.role: JPEG encoding for export (quality + 4:4:4/4:2:0 control, ICC APP2 embedding) and JPEG-compressed RAW container support inside LibRaw.
dependencies.rationale: Latest stable tag at pin time; SIMD disabled in our build for a deterministic toolchain-free build, which is a performance trade-off documented in the G1 report.

dependencies.role: JSON value model + SAX parser used behind a strict wrapper (duplicate keys, depth, non-finite rejected).
Unit test framework (test tooling only; not part of the product pipeline).

auditCorrection.reason: Vendored header is byte-identical to fetched upstream v2.5.3 header; previous manifest entry did not match either file. Header bytes were not changed.

inHouse.role: SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4) implemented in-engine for source/asset hashing.
inHouse.rationale: Avoids pulling a crypto dependency for one algorithm; validated against standard test vectors in unit tests.

inHouse.role: Deterministic sRGB ICC v2 matrix/TRC profile generated in-engine.
inHouse.rationale: Avoids shipping a third-party profile (provenance/licensing simplicity); parse-checked with Pillow's ImageCms in tooling tests.
